# Exclusion audit over the G1 tracker population (generated by scripts/g1_exclusion_audit_tracker.py)

n = 27 excluded comparator trials: every tracker trial the shared exclusion audit (outputs/k_gap/exclusion_audit.json) does not cover. By class: {'TRUE_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE': 15, 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORD': 8, 'NOT_AN_EXCLUSION': 3, 'SCREENER_ERROR': 1}.

TRUE_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE = the record states the excluding fact (protocol rule named). SCREENER_ERROR = our screen is wrong (FIXED_IN_HARNESS where this change fixed the class). INSUFFICIENT_RECORD = the record lacks the fact; open full text was sought through the cascade (g1/data/audit_ft). Reader axes: the recorded, quote-verified second reading (c=comparator, d=design, i=intervention, p=population).
